title: double-checked locking in JWKS cache correctly prevents thunder-herd
description: oidc.rs get_keys() uses a two-phase lock: read lock for the fast path (cache hit), write lock for the slow path with an inner re-check before fetching. This is correct double-checked locking for an async RwLock. A contributor might suggest simplifying to a single write lock always, which would serialize all JWKS lookups under the lock. The current pattern is correct: the read lock allows concurrent cache hits, and the inner re-check under write lock prevents the thunder-herd where N concurrent cache-misses each fetch fresh JWKS. Worth defending.
